key_features: 【Size Information】This is a small-sized extendable sink organizer. Please check your sink dimensions before purchasing to ensure the sink width does NOT exceed 16 inches.

【High-quality Material】This product is made of premium ABS material, which is known for its smooth, refined surface, excellent wear resistance, and impact resistance. Durable and not easily deformed, ABS material also boasts moisture and rust resistance, maintaining its pristine condition even in humid kitchen environments.

【Space-saving Telescopic Design】The length of this product can be adjusted to fit various sink sizes, offering flexibility. This design not only saves kitchen space but also keeps the countertop clean and tidy, optimizing the workflow and spatial arrangement in the kitchen.

【Drainage Hole Design】The bottom of the product is equipped with evenly distributed drainage holes of an appropriate size, which prevent water accumulation and facilitate quick drainage. This helps the items in the drainer basket to dry quickly, maintaining good ventilation and hygiene, and preventing bacterial growth.

【Includes a Tray with Drainage Holes】 The product comes with a small tray featuring drainage holes that can be placed on top of the main product or used separately. Its presence enhances the functionality of the product, making it suitable for quick drainage of kitchen utensils or ingredients, offering flexible and convenient usage.

【Thoughtful Design】To enhance stability and longevity, non-slip pads are fitted to the bottom of the product. These pads effectively prevent the product from sliding in wet conditions and also protect stainless steel sinks from abrasion, reducing the risk of scratches and damage.

【Multipurpose and Multifunctional】Designed to meet diverse storage needs in the kitchen, this product can store kitchen towels, scrub brushes, sponges, steel wool, cleaning agents, and other cleaning tools. It can also be used as a drainer for dishes, cups, and fruits. This multifunctional design facilitates more efficient and organized kitchen management.
【Note】Please check the pictures and size information on the details page before purchasing.
